# Home Assistant integration for UniFi Drive / UNAS v0.8.0 - Reliability and release-line hardening

Maintenance release focused on setup reliability, device-registry behavior, and
recorder/config-entry write hygiene.

## Breaking change: reinstall required

Versions before `0.8.0` should not be upgraded in place. Remove the old Home
Assistant integration entry first, then remove the old custom integration
installation before installing this release again. This is required so the old
`custom_components/unifi_drive` folder is removed and Home Assistant creates a
fresh `unifi_unas` config entry and entity registry state.

Recommended upgrade path:

1. In Home Assistant, open `Settings` -> `Devices & services`.
2. Open the existing UniFi Drive / UNAS integration entry.
3. Choose `Delete` and confirm removal of the config entry. This removes the
   old configured device from Home Assistant.
4. Restart Home Assistant.
5. In HACS, remove the old custom integration installation. A normal in-place
   update is not enough when the old integration folder still exists.
6. Restart Home Assistant again so the old custom integration folder is no
   longer loaded.
7. Install this release through HACS again. For manual installs, delete
   `custom_components/unifi_drive/` and copy the current
   `custom_components/unifi_unas/` folder.
8. Restart Home Assistant after the new files are in place.
9. Add `UniFi Drive / UNAS` from `Settings` -> `Devices & services`.
10. Configure the device again and re-enable only the optional features you want
    to expose.

Do not copy an old config entry back into Home Assistant storage. Recreate the
entry through the UI so discovery identity, unique IDs, diagnostics and optional
feature state are initialized with the current release behavior.

## Highlights

- Fixes the frontend setup race that could show `Invalid flow specified` after
  submitting `UniFi Drive optional features` even though the entry was created.
- Allows Home Assistant-managed device entries for this integration to be
  removed without a restart cycle.
- Throttles metadata-only discovery identity writes so repeated observations do
  not persist `discovery_last_seen` on every short-interval trigger.
- Applies the same write-throttle behavior to config-flow discovery matching and
  setup-time validated identity updates.
- Simplifies current config-entry identity matching around device-scoped IDs and
  keeps discovery dedupe behavior covered by focused tests.
- Keeps diagnostics, HACS metadata, quality-scale tracking, snapshot inventory,
  and optional local control behavior intact.

## Live validation summary

The setup fix was verified through the Home Assistant frontend:

- Discovery card `Add`
- Connection form submit
- `UniFi Drive optional features` submit
- Flow API sequence: `200 form`, `200 form`, `200 create_entry`
- No visible `Invalid flow specified` error
- Created entry loaded through zeroconf
- Device-registry removal accepted without a restart cycle

The recorder/config-entry write probe remains documented in
`docs/live_db_probe.md` and continues to cover the discovery write-throttle
behavior included in this release.
